control.description-key: PBS Hub host app H-7 Skor saya: the credit score of the signed-in host with its level, points this month, the levels of the studio and every reward and penalty.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: scoreInitial, scoreMin, scoreMax from [FAS STUDIO] ScoreConfig, used when the Host row has no score.

property.name: HostJson
property.description-key: JSON row of the signed-in host [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, HostCode, NamaHost, Package, CurrentScore, InitialScore. Never send KTP or bank data.

property.name: ScoreTxJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreTransactions for this host, newest first: ID, TransactionID, RuleID, TransactionType, Point, ScoreBefore, ScoreAfter, Reason, Notes, Status, CreatedDate.

property.name: ThresholdsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [FAS STUDIO] HostScoreThreshold: ThresholdID, Label, Description, MinimumScore, MaximumScore, Tone, Active, SortOrder.

property.name: RulesJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON rows of the score rules: RuleID, RuleName, RuleType, Point, Description, Active. Empty: the rules are read from the transactions.

property.name: Period
property.description-key: Month shown in the summary and the list, yyyy-mm, or All. Empty means the current month.

property.name: HasMore
property.description-key: true when the server has more transactions than were sent: shows Muat lebih banyak (LOAD_MORE).

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeleton rows.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message}. The screen is read only; the reply is only shown as a banner.
